title: A Blackbird's Day From Ground to Song
caption:
FROM A GARDEN SEARCH TO A DAWN SONG. Different real common blackbirds in separate settings. #WildVox #Blackbird #Birdwatching

narration_timeline.text: A common blackbird pauses with food in its beak, revealing what it found in a garden.
narration_timeline.scene: Close blackbird visibly carrying a worm and foraging in botanical garden.

narration_timeline.text: In another park, a blackbird stays close to stones and low vegetation.
narration_timeline.scene: Close blackbird resting on rocky park ground.

narration_timeline.text: Across different afternoons, the birds move between leaves and open ground, checking each patch.
narration_timeline.scene: Two real blackbird park scenes in Ljubljana.

narration_timeline.text: Searching near grass can bring worms and insects within reach, even on busy days.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird in Tivoli park; food type explained without fake closeup.

narration_timeline.text: Then the soundtrack changes: a blackbird sings from a perch before dawn.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual dark predawn blackbird singing on rooftop antenna, clearly marked dawn.

narration_timeline.text: Later, other blackbirds return to the city's ground-level spaces, where their search continues.
narration_timeline.scene: Two separate blackbird ground-level park/city scenes.
